name: PeaZip
tagline: Free file archiver and encryption utility supporting 200+ formats
description: PeaZip is a free file archiver utility, based on open source technologies of 7-Zip, p7zip, FreeArc, PAQ, and PEA projects. It provides a powerful file manager with two-factor authentication, secure deletion, and strong AES-256 encryption.
features: Open, create, and extract 200+ archive formats (7Z, TAR, ZIP, RAR)
Strong AES-256 encryption with two-factor keyfile authentication
Built-in file checksum and hash calculator (CRC, MD5, SHA-256)
Secure file shredder and duplicate file finder
requirements: Linux 64-bit desktop with GTK or Qt
